text:
violet_marketing: quick sync  were targeting Tue 10:00 PT for the public announcement. marketing needs: final changelog link, docs landing URL, a one-line perf stat + a 280-char social variant, and a tiny demo snippet (curl). can eng/product commit to EOD tomorrow? :calendar:

sam_eng: changelog PR is in review, should land by EOD. docs draft is up but needs product sign-off. pinging @ana_product for the "what this means" bullets and migration note.

ana_product: (typo: actually @ana_product) i'll review docs this afternoon and add a short "what this means" section and a single clarity sentence for support/SDR copy. webinar: is Wed 11am PT still the plan?

violet_marketing: yes Wed 11am PT for the live Q&A/demo. marketing also wants two tweet variants (A/B): short factoid vs. benefit-first. need both by EOD so we can schedule.

sam_eng: perf draft for the short factoid: "~19% median text-gen latency improvement at 512 tokens; typical unit cost down ~24% with default batching + KV cache." Use for variant A. Variant B (benefit): "Faster responses and lower cost for production text-gen workloads  see the upgrade notes."

jordan_relops: rollout plan: prechecks 09:45 PT, canary start 09:50 PT, announce embargo lift 10:05 PT, ramp to 100% by 12:30 PT (gradual 25% steps). infra-bot will run the canary precheck at 09:40 PT. we will only lift embargo after canary health=OK.

infra-bot: Canary precheck scheduled: start=2026-11-03T09:40:00Z, target=canary-pool-11, alert-channel=#eng-oncall if fail.

sam_eng: docs link placeholder: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-11-inference-update (final slug TBD). changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/614

violet_marketing: marketing asks changelog to include: 1) "What this means for you" (2 bullets), 2) a short curl example, 3) inbound routing note for SDRs (tag + queue). can eng/product add those?

ana_product: (again @ana_product) inbound routing note: marketing leads go to SDR queue "launch-inbound" with tag "2026-11-infer" and priority=high for first 48h. i'll add that to docs and the webinar slide. support blurb draft: "No API changes required for most customers; update client for optimized batching and cache benefits. See migration notes."

sam_eng: adding two bullets and curl example to the changelog now. curl sample: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rw1-large","input":"Summarize the following text"}'
```

tyler_marketing: i'll draft both tweet variants + a 280-char email subject/preview. marketing wants to run the two tweet variants as an A/B test for 24h and use the winner for the newsletter teaser. i'll post drafts for eng accuracy check before scheduling.

jordan_relops: rollback criteria for the slide: sustained error rate > 1% for 5 minutes OR P95 latency > 2x baseline for 10 minutes. also please include a brief note in changelog that canary traffic may observe slight variance in latency for the first 15 minutes.

violet_marketing: timeline recap: EOD tomorrow = changelog merged + docs reviewed + tweet variants and 280-char teaser + demo curl snippet. 09:40 PT infra precheck, 09:50 PT canary, embargo lift 10:05 PT after canary healthy, ramp to 100% by 12:30 PT, webinar Wed 11am PT. confirm here and i'll lock calendar and social queue. :white_check_mark:

sam_eng: confirmed from eng. merging changelog and adding requested bullets/snippets now.

ana_product: confirmed  i'll drop the support blurb and inbound routing note into the docs and the shared slides by 5pm PT.

tyler_marketing: confirmed  will post tweet drafts here for one last engineering sanity check before scheduling.

sam_eng: update: final perf after one more run is 17% median improvement (was ~19%). updating PR and docs now. prefixing with "update:" as requested.

violet_marketing: update noted  using 17% in the shortline and in variant A. please keep updating here for any further number tweaks. locking calendar and will freeze social copy 2 hours before announce. thanks everyone :rocket:
